notes: Offer statics for the two store bundles (user request Oct 11). O42_01–06: Pod Denture Bundle ($99.95, compare-at $180, save $80, 3 free gifts: travel bag $25, portable case $19, 1-year warranty $14, + 120-day guarantee). O42_07–12: Ultimate Cleaning Bundle ($169.95, compare-at $300, save $130: Pod + Travel Pod + 30 antibacterial tablets). Prices and values from the store pages. 2 cartoon formats.
